build_note: Verilator elaboration used the campaign all-unit X_IDX=2 DPI configuration. The generated C++ build was completed using OPT_FAST=-O0 OPT_SLOW=-O0 after default -Os compiled all but one large translation unit. Compiler optimization changes host simulation speed, not RTL configuration.
claim_boundary: Reduced single-token functional gate with DPI arithmetic stand-ins, QE weight HBM, pooled index-key HBM and timed four-stack HBM models. The 438968 simulation cycles are not a production performance estimate.
